direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; FactoryStage at least 55vw and 60vh, no page scroll, only inspector and task lists scroll internally
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary #A8F04A on #050705, one per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text, preserving the required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on a real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible focus ring on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail generated from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, never conflating their controls or status; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the extra logo block in the inspector; retain only the header logo and the opening-story placement, and give that saved height to source evidence.
Enlarge the 120 versus 80 comparison tracks and place DOES NOT MATCH in clear space so the discrepancy reads instantly at 1366x768.
Link each evidence row to its SVG track and machine node with hover, focus ring and bidirectional highlighting.
Separate pre-flight nonce and identity route-health checks into their own labelled group, distinct in heading, border and status from the investigation task below.
Enlarge the route selector to a 40px minimum target and add a clear selected-state check plus focus ring.
Shorten the offline explanation to one instruction and one status sentence so the primary action is visible without inspector scrolling.
Add a visible focus ring and live character-match state to the typed consent field, keeping Accept disabled until the exact phrase matches.
Move SELECTED text off the price figure and align finish and incremental values in fixed tabular columns across all three paths.
On selection, trace only the chosen feasible route once in the SVG, leaving stopped and idle machines visually quiet.
Keep PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL attached to each task card, not only the panel header, so no proposal reads as tracked work.
Reduce route-label overlap around MAT-ALLOY-B and the two job allocations by shifting labels into clear SVG lanes.
Make the inspector task list fully keyboard reachable with arrow keys, a visible focus ring and an announced untracked status.
Strengthen the preview state for CELL-MILL-2 with dashed red outline, PREVIEW marker and text, while reserving solid red cross-hatch for the applied stopped state.
Enlarge the machine selector to 40px and pair the dropdown change with an immediate SVG preview and status-centre warning in the DecisionBar.
Dim the Scenario Management admin text or move it into a clearly secondary zone so Apply second shock remains the sole primary.
Sharpen the solid red cross-hatch and OFFLINE label on CELL-MILL-2 and confirm no feasible route line touches or crosses that cell.
Keep pre-flight nonce and identity route-health separate from the reinvestigation evidence action, with independent headings, statuses and buttons.
Surface the change summary, 3 to 2 feasible paths, as a compact delta chip beside the stage title rather than a full-width dark band.
Keep CONSTRAINED Split available capacity disabled with its reason visible, and prevent its radio control from receiving activation.
Add a visible focus ring, exact-match progress and aria-live confirmation to the revised typed consent field before Accept revised decision can enable.
Align the constrained row placeholders so finish and cost columns stay tabular with the two feasible options.
Visually split the inspector into Blocked prior tracked work and Proposed untracked replacements, stating beside the approved plan that replacements await approval.
Fix clipped route labels near the recovery flow line by moving allocation text below the neon path with leader dots.
Add counts, 3 blocked and proposed count untracked, as small summary chips above the task lists to speed scanning within the viewport.
Order the proof actions as a numbered sequence: enter passphrase, seal packet, verify ledger, export independent checkpoint, with only the current step enabled.
Enlarge the passphrase field and its rule text, and announce strength and completion through text and marker, never colour alone.
Compress the Before-After strip so all proof controls fit at 1366x768 without pushing the DecisionBar primary below the fold.
Add a completion summary band with sealed packet, 18 events, revised plan accepted and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained, using text and markers alongside colour.
Set final focus to the Recovery story complete heading and mark the rail completion item aria-current for keyboard and screen-reader users.
Keep the completion logo count at two total placements; retain the header mark and do not add a celebratory duplicate in the inspector.
